root_cause_label: Fabricated answer from parametric memory after network access was blocked
one_sentence_failure_summary: After all network attempts to retrieve the MTEB Scandinavian leaderboard were blocked by a proxy, the agent decided to guess the top model from parametric memory rather than pursuing offline alternatives (e.g., cloning the embeddings-benchmark/results repo), producing an incorrect answer.
t_err_evidence: Step 9 (think step): agent explicitly acknowledges it cannot access live leaderboard data and decides to 'make an educated determination' by selecting KBLab/sentence-bert-swedish-cased based on memory, abandoning further data-retrieval strategies.
t_commit_evidence: Step 10: agent writes 'KBLab/sentence-bert-swedish-cased' to /app/result.txt, committing the fabricated incorrect answer; the correct answer is GritLM/GritLM-7B.
t_surface_evidence: Step 10: the incorrect model name is written to /app/result.txt, making the failure observable.
trigger_explanation: The agent falsely assumes (without verification) that KBLab/sentence-bert-swedish-cased is the top-ranked model on the Scandinavian MTEB leaderboard. After failing to retrieve live data, it acts on this unverified belief from training-time parametric memory instead of exploring offline strategies like cloning the embeddings-benchmark/results repository.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3: ProxyError('Unable to connect to proxy', OSError('Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden')) when attempting to reach huggingface.co — clear early signal that all external network access is blocked, which ultimately forces the agent into guessing.
fabrication_evidence: Step 10 writes 'KBLab/sentence-bert-swedish-cased' to /app/result.txt based purely on parametric memory with no retrieved evidence; step 11 claims task is complete with this fabricated answer.
